items.title: Widerspruch against the contribution assessment
items.quote: Widerspruch gegen die Beitragsfestsetzung ist binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe möglich; Sie können ihn schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der IKK Nordmuster, Innungsplatz 7, 24539 Musterneumünster, einlegen.
items.computation: IKK Nordmuster is a statutory health insurer, a social-law body under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X. The letter is dated (posted) 2027-10-01 (Friday). Under the PostModG 4-day delivery fiction for letters posted on/after 1 Jan 2025, delivery is deemed on the 4th calendar day after posting: 01.10.2027 + 4 days = 05.10.2027 (Tuesday). For non-tax authorities/social-law bodies the deemed delivery day itself is not moved even if it fell on a weekend/holiday (here it is a Tuesday anyway, so moot). The one-month Widerspruch period (§ 84 SGG) then runs from delivery under §§ 187, 188 BGB: the day of delivery (05.10.2027) is not counted, and the period ends one month later on the day with the same number, i.e. 05.11.2027 (Friday). This is not a Saturday, Sunday or NRW public holiday, so no further shift applies (§ 26 Abs. 3 SGB X).

items.title: Monthly contribution direct debit (new amount)
items.quote: Den Beitrag buchen wir wie bisher zum 15. des Folgemonats von Ihrem Konto ab.
items.computation: The new monthly contribution of 451,54 € applies from 01.11.2027. Per the letter's standing rule, the contribution is debited by SEPA direct debit on the 15th of the following month. The first debit reflecting the new amount is therefore for the November 2027 contribution, collected on 15.12.2027 (Wednesday, no weekend/holiday adjustment needed). This is a recurring monthly debit (continuing on the 15th of each subsequent month) rather than a one-off deadline the person must act on; no action is required from the policyholder beyond ensuring sufficient account funds.

warnings: This document uses obviously fictitious placeholder names and addresses throughout (e.g. sender 'IKK Nordmuster' in 'Musterneumünster', recipient 'Laura Beispielwinkel' in 'Musterlingen am Neckar', 'Musterbank Nord'), indicating it is a sample/template letter rather than a genuine real-world notice; verify all details against the actual document if this was meant to be a real letter.

The Land in which the sending office sits cannot be reliably determined from the fictitious address, so NRW public holidays (the recipient's own Land) were used for the Widerspruch deadline calculation as instructed; this made no difference to the resulting date in this case.
